guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: For 2026, the Company reaffirms Adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $950 million to $1,050 million and FCF to be in the range of $350 million to $450 million. For details, please refer to the "2026 Outlook" section of the 2025 Annual Report for the assumptions which have remained the same.

The following table outlines our expectations on key financial targets and related assumptions for 2026 and should be read in conjunction with the narrative discussion that follows and the "Risk Management" section of the 2025 Annual MD&A:

Measure | 9 months ended Sept. 30, 2026(2) | 2026 Target(3) | 2025 Actual(4)
Adjusted EBITDA(1) | $759 million | $950 million to $1,050 million | $1,104 million
FCF(1) | $338 million | $350 million to $450 million | $514 million
FCF per share(1) | $1.11 | $1.18 to $1.51 | $1.73
Dividend per share | $0.14 | $0.28 annualized | $0.26 annualized

(2)The nine month ended Sept. 30, 2026 amounts for the most directly comparable IFRS measures for Adjusted EBITDA and FCF were as follows: Earnings before income taxes of $203 million and cash flow from operating activities of $317 million. The most directly comparable IFRS ratio to FCF per share is cash flow from operating activities per share of $1.04. Refer to the "Non-IFRS and Supplementary Financial Measures" section of this MD&A for additional information.
